caption:
Making money online with AI is real. Here are 5 ways people are doing it right now

1) Faceless YouTube channel, no camera. Some channels hit $2K/month.
"Script a 10-min video about [topic]. Hook in 10 seconds, 5 facts."

2) T-shirts on Redbubble.
"10 T-shirt slogans for [niche] fans. Punchy, under 6 words."
Free to list, no upfront cost.

3) Etsy listings on Upwork, $30 each.
"Etsy listing for [item]. 5 buyer keywords, main benefit."

4) $29 per customer, build a web tool anyone can use.
"Web app: someone types job title, gets 5 AI tools for that job."

5) Restaurants, gyms, salons, local businesses pay $200 a month for a newsletter they don't have time to write.
"Newsletter for [business] on [topic]. Warm, 300 words, one action."

SAVE THIS: 5 AI income streams, start tonight.

Making money online kept being called a scam because the old tactics were tricks. AI rewrote the rules. Anyone with one good prompt and a platform can get paid. The people who figured it out are not waiting.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
